title: fix(app-shell): the chrome's nine unread reads start after the console's first paint, not beside the page's own (objectui#12980, part 3)
body:
Part of #12980
Clause-②: no

Part 3 of 3: the card's Wanted item 3, the calls the page does not read. Parts 1 and 2 (`024b7b6`, `736b9ce`) landed the page-route object scope and the route chunk preload; neither is touched here. This PR leaves the card open for the PM, who closes it after the re-measure.

## What changed

Each read now starts after the console's first paint (the boot splash is gone and a frame has painted), or when its surface opens. Nothing is removed that a surface still reads, and no package entry gains an export, prop or type member.

- `sharedUserFeeds.ts` gains `useAfterFirstPaint` (package-internal). It watches `LoadingScreen`'s `data-boot-splash` marker, then waits one frame. The answer is module-wide and one-way, so a header that remounts on a layout switch does not hide its badge for a frame. Every shared feed attaches only after it. The Activity feed also takes `enabled`, and while that is false it does not ask whether `sys_activity` exists either.
- `AppHeader.tsx` no longer destructures the lazy `dashboards` / `pages` / `reports` getters. It reads each one only in the branch for the route type that names it (the phone bar's title). The bell is wrapped in a `contents` span whose pointer-enter, focus and click turn on the Activity feed.
- `useNavigationSync.ts`: `NavigationSyncEffect` reads `pages` / `dashboards` only after the first paint. Its effect returns early before then, so it never seeds an empty baseline, and the existing load-state guard is unchanged.
- `useUserLocale.ts`: the `sys_user` read waits for the first paint. It is kept as a separate read, as the next section explains.
- `plugin-chatbot/useAgents.ts`: the catalog request leaves after the first frame has painted, at once for a surface that mounts after that. It deliberately does not wait for the boot splash, because the `/ai` route guard asks for the catalog while the splash is up.
- `apps/console/loadLocales.ts` gains `whenBootPainted()` (one promise per page load). The locale list waits for it, and so does `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx`'s settings read. The locale list now asks for the session after the paint, at the moment it sends, so a sign-out during the wait sends nothing. The first run of the family caught exactly that, as an anonymous `401`.

## A1: the nine calls

| Call | Reader | What reads it on first paint | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `meta/dashboard` | `AppHeader` getter (phone title on dashboard routes); `NavigationSyncEffect` (its diff) | nothing on a non-dashboard route | Header: read only on a dashboard route. Sync: after the first paint, guard kept. |
| `meta/report` | `AppHeader` getter (phone title on report routes) | nothing on a non-report route | Read only on a report route, so it is gone from every other route. |
| `approvals/requests` | `sharedUserFeeds` approvals feed | the bell badge's second addend | After the first paint. The badge draws nothing until it lands, which is also its state while any read is in flight, and never a `0`. |
| `data/sys_activity` | `sharedUserFeeds` activity feed | nothing (the bell's Activity tab only) | On the bell's open intent (pointer, focus, click). Its `meta/object/sys_activity` presence probe goes with it. Home's card and the `global:notifications` block still read it, after the paint. |
| `data/sys_inbox_message` (+ receipts) | `sharedUserFeeds` inbox feed | the bell badge's first addend | After the first paint. The badge behaves as for approvals. |
| `ai/agents` | `useAgents` (via `useAiSurfaceEnabled`, `ChatDock`, Home) | nothing: every AI entry point stays hidden while the catalog loads | After the first frame. See the ruling note below. |
| `data/sys_user/ID` | `useSignedInUserLocale` | nothing: the first paint renders from the device cache | Kept, after the first paint. `GET /auth/me/localization` answers `locale` as the column when set, else `Accept-Language`, else the deployment default, and does not say which. This hook must tell an unset column apart from a set one, so it cannot use that answer. |
| `api/settings` | `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt` (`findTimezoneOffer`) | nothing: a dialog over a page that has not painted | After the first paint (`whenBootPainted`). |
| `i18n/locales` | console `loadLocales` (for `I18nProvider`) | nothing: the globe menu opens on a click, and the language column is applied after the paint | After the first paint (`whenBootPainted`), with the session asked at send time. |

**Ruling note: `ai/agents` "when the chat dock opens".** I did not take this literally. The catalog is not only the dock's agent list. It is the signal `useAiSurfaceEnabled` uses to decide whether the FAB, the header's AI button and the dock draw at all, and that decision is per user: an empty catalog hides the surface for a user without an AI seat (ADR-0068). Fetching it only when the dock opens would mean drawing the launcher before knowing whether this user may use it, which the hook's header forbids. Under the ruling's general clause ("starts after first paint, or only when its surface opens"), it now starts after the first frame. Whether to go further is an open question in the report.

## A2: measurement (the part-2 trace rig, rebuilt)

The rig is the same as part 2's: a production `vite build` of the console, `vite preview` proxying `/api` to a fake API with 50 ms per call, and Playwright Chromium. It ran on `/apps/crm/page/welcome` (one app; its navigation holds a page, a dashboard and a report), with one warm-up open and three warm opens per build, in one browser page. Counts are Resource Timing entries under `/api/`, read 6 s after each `goto`.

| build | calls started before the page body painted | all calls in 6 s | splash left before any deferred read started |
|---|---|---|---|
| base `cb80001` (the seven source files reverted, rebuilt) | 23 / 23 / 23 | 26 / 26 / 26 | no: `api/settings`, `sys_user`, `meta/dashboard`, `meta/report` and `meta/object/sys_activity` all started before it |
| head `41eda07` | 15 / 15 / 15 | 22 / 24 / 24 | yes: the seven deferred reads start 4–10 ms after the page paints |

- Gone from the open entirely: `meta/report` and `meta/object/sys_activity`. In this rig the app lists no object, so the activity roster is empty and the base build sent no `data/sys_activity`; on a deployment with a roster, base sends it too and head does not.
- Moved after the paint: `ai/agents`, `api/settings`, `i18n/locales`, `meta/dashboard` (the sync), `approvals/requests`, `data/sys_inbox_message`, and `data/sys_user/u1`.
- The remaining 15 before paint are the boot and route reads. They include `auth/me/localization` twice; see the acceptance notes.
- These counts come from a fake API, not from the card's cloud measurement (24 / 26). The card's budget of 15 is met by the calls before paint; counted to settle, the deferred reads still happen, after the page.

## A3: pins

- `AppHeader.deferredChromeReads-12980.test.tsx`: an object route reads none of the three lists, and a dashboard / page / report route reads only its own (CONTROLs). The inbox and approvals are not read while the boot splash is up and are read once it is gone. The Activity feed is read on the bell's open intent, not on mount. CONTROL: while the approvals read is pending the badge is absent (no `0`), and once it lands the badge reads `2`.
- `chromeReads.afterFirstPaint-12980.test.tsx`: `NavigationSyncEffect` reads neither list under the splash and both after it. `useSignedInUserLocale` does not call `findOne('sys_user')` under the splash, then reads it and applies `ja`. The Activity feed asks the app scope for no name until it is enabled, then asks for `sys_activity`.
- `useAgents.afterFirstFrame-12980.test.tsx`, with the frame held by hand: no request in the mounting commit, and the request goes out when the frame paints. CONTROL: once a frame has painted, a later mount reads at once.
- `loadLocales.afterBootPaint-12980.test.ts`: no read under the splash, then the codes once it is gone. CONTROL: a sign-out during the wait sends nothing.
- `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.afterBootPaint-12980.test.tsx`: no `GET /api/settings` under the splash; once it is gone, the read goes out and the prompt opens.
- Ablation, done once at `72cc91d` with `ablation-replace.mjs` (`AppHeader.tsx` is byte-identical at `41eda07`, blob `677c9c19`). `AppHeader`'s `useSharedActivityFeed({ enabled: activityWanted && !activities })` was changed to `{ enabled: !activities }`, so the feed starts on mount again. The anchor went from 1 hit to 0, and the blob went from `677c9c19` to `5b7f0142`. Result: "reads the Activity feed on the bell's open intent, not on mount" turned red (`expected 1 to be +0`), 1 failed and 6 passed. Restore: `git checkout HEAD --`, after which the blob equals HEAD (`677c9c19`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Existing suites that check what these feeds read now start past the first paint (`__markFirstPainted()` in `beforeEach`). The bell's Activity cases in `AppHeader.inboxVariant` click the bell first. `i18nAfterSignIn-12034` now waits for the locale read, which lands a beat after the heading re-renders.

## Verification at `41eda07`

- Type-check: `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot run type-check`, both "Done" (each config includes `src/**/*.test.ts(x)`). `@object-ui/console` `type-check` exited 0 at `7feeb6b`; console sources are unchanged since.
- Tests, `vitest run --maxWorkers=1` from the repo root:
  - the app-shell reader families, new pins and `src/*.ratchet.test.ts`: 84 files, 602 tests passed;
  - the console families, the console pins, the `useAgents` pin and the i18n provider test: 10 files, 310 passed;
  - the whole `packages/plugin-chatbot/` directory (at `7feeb6b`, unchanged since): 72 files, 738 passed.
- Declared to CI, NOT MEASURED locally: the whole `packages/app-shell/` directory (1583 test files, beyond the foreground limit at one worker) and the whole `apps/console/` directory (the attempt hit the 560 s timeout, exit 124, with no failure printed before it).
- Lint, narrowed: `eslint` from the root config on the 29 changed `.ts` / `.tsx` files, read from `--format json`, gave 0 errors and 68 warnings. Of those warnings, 20 are on added lines: AppHeader's existing `as any` casts on the renamed getter reads, and the mock harness copied from `AppHeader.inboxVariant`. The config has no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`), and no custom rule reads another file, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Gates, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:doc-example-readers`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:side-effects-array`, `check:element-data-source-declaration`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:action-forward-parity`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:icon-record-names`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs` and `scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`. `check:spec-floors` exited 1; it does so on main too, so it is recorded and not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** The claim places `WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.tsx` under `packages/app-shell/src/`, but it lives in `apps/console/src/pages/settings/`, and it was changed there. The shared `whenBootPainted()` lives in `loadLocales.ts`, the other console reader in the claim, rather than in a new module. The existing tests edited are the reader families named above.
- **Behaviour change.** The bell's opening tab is chosen from the counts when it is clicked. A user whose remembered tab is Activity, and who clicks the bell before the Activity read lands, now opens on the first non-empty tab. Hovering usually loads it first.
- **Hidden tabs.** A tab opened in the background paints no frame, so these reads wait until the tab is first shown.
- **Observed, not in scope.** `GET /api/v1/auth/me/localization` is read twice on every warm open in the rig, once by the boot seed path and once by `LocalizationFetchProvider` (their `sharedGetJson` dedupe covers only overlapping flights). `data/sys_user_preference` is read three times. Both are listed for the PM in the report, as this card's family.
